title: Kaiju No. 8 Original Short Anime "Narumis Week at Work"
jp_title: Kaiju No. 8 Original Short Anime 'Narumi's Week at Work'
description: An official original short anime spin-off of Kaiju No. 8, spotlighting Gen Narumi — captain of the Defense Force’s First Division and hailed as Japan’s strongest anti-kaiju fighter. Overwhelmingly powerful and utterly insufferable about it, Narumi skips meetings, dodges paperwork, and spends every spare second gaming online. But even the strongest man on earth gets humbled now and then by the most unexpected counterattacks. A four-episode bite-size comedy about the strongest man’s anything-but-peaceful everyday life.
